entries.text: I once traveled to the Grand Canyon.
One memorable trip was to Yellowstone National Park.
entries.translation: 一次难忘的旅行是去黄石国家公园。

translations.zh-Hans: 一次难忘的旅行是去黄石国家公园。

entries.text: In 2019, I went to San Francisco with my friends.
We decided to explore the Rocky Mountains in the fall.
entries.translation: 我们决定在秋天探索落基山脉。

translations.zh-Hans: 我们决定在秋天探索落基山脉。

entries.text: We expected sunny weather, but it rained every day.
entries.translation: 我们期待晴天，但每天都下雨。

translations.zh-Hans: 我们期待晴天，但每天都下雨。

entries.text: I remember it because we got lost in the city.
entries.translation: 我记得是因为我们在城市里迷路了。

translations.zh-Hans: 我记得是因为我们在城市里迷路了。

entries.text: The concert was supposed to start at 8, but it was delayed.
entries.translation: 音乐会本应在8点开始，但被推迟了。

translations.zh-Hans: 音乐会本应在8点开始，但被推迟了。

entries.text: We missed our flight and had to stay an extra night.
entries.translation: 我们错过了航班，不得不多住了一晚。

translations.zh-Hans: 我们错过了航班，不得不多住了一晚。

entries.text: The guide who showed us around was really knowledgeable.
entries.translation: 带我们参观的导游非常博学。

translations.zh-Hans: 带我们参观的导游非常博学。

entries.text: The highlight of the trip was seeing the Northern Lights.
entries.translation: 旅行的亮点是看到北极光。

translations.zh-Hans: 旅行的亮点是看到北极光。

entries.text: The street performer played the violin beautifully.
entries.translation: 街头艺人小提琴拉得很美。

translations.zh-Hans: 街头艺人小提琴拉得很美。

entries.text: The local market was full of vibrant colors and sounds.
entries.translation: 当地市场充满了鲜艳的色彩和声音。

translations.zh-Hans: 当地市场充满了鲜艳的色彩和声音。

entries.text: I felt a sense of peace walking through the forest.
entries.translation: 在森林中漫步时，我感到一种宁静。

translations.zh-Hans: 在森林中漫步时，我感到一种宁静。

entries.text: What made it special was the kindness of the locals.
entries.translation: 特别之处在于当地人的善良。

translations.zh-Hans: 特别之处在于当地人的善良。

entries.text: I learned a lot about the culture and history of the area.
entries.translation: 我学到了很多关于该地区的文化和历史。

translations.zh-Hans: 我学到了很多关于该地区的文化和历史。

entries.text: It was a trip that reminded me of the beauty of nature.
entries.translation: 这次旅行让我想起了大自然的美丽。

translations.zh-Hans: 这次旅行让我想起了大自然的美丽。
